# Skédio

> Skédio is a creative studio crafting bold brands, intuitive digital experiences, and scalable digital products that help businesses grow.

## About
- [About Skédio](https://www.skediodesign.in/about): Meet the team, leadership, and craft philosophy behind Skédio.

## Core Services
- [Services Overview](https://www.skediodesign.in/services): The full studio service lineup — product design, brand identity, UI/UX, and product development.
- [Product Design](https://www.skediodesign.in/services/product-design): User research, UX strategy, interaction design, prototyping, and scalable product design systems.
- [Brand Identity & Visual Systems](https://www.skediodesign.in/services/brand-identity): Distinctive logomarks, typography hierarchies, custom color systems, and comprehensive brand design books.
- [UI/UX & Digital Product Design](https://www.skediodesign.in/services/ui-ux-design): User flow architecture, interactive wireframing, high-fidelity interfaces, and accessible design systems.
- [Full-Stack Product Development](https://www.skediodesign.in/services/product-development): Modern SSR web applications (React, TanStack, TypeScript), mobile development, and scalable cloud architectures.

## Selected Work & Case Studies
- [Projects Overview](https://www.skediodesign.in/projects): The full case study index, grouped by discipline.
- [HAO Cabs — Taxi Bidding Experience Case Study](https://www.skediodesign.in/projects/haocabs): Complete product design and UX architecture for a real-time ride-bidding mobile platform connecting passengers and drivers.
- [Tiffinly — Multi-role Food Subscription Platform](https://www.skediodesign.in/projects/tiffinly): Three unified mobile experiences connecting customers, tiffin providers, and delivery partners through a single ecosystem.
- [EDIOS — Video Production Studio Identity](https://www.skediodesign.in/projects/edios): Brand identity and art direction for a video production studio.
